title: Rosalind and the Regiment
author: Mara Joubert
blurb: Sable Whitlock, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the century turns.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
